#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

int add(int a, int b) {
    int res = a + b;
    if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
    return res;
}

int getVal(const vector<vector<vector<int>>>& dp, int i, int j, bool selectStart, bool selectEnd) {
    int ret = 0;
    if (i - j >= 2) {
        if (selectStart) {
            ret = add(ret, dp[i-1][j+1][1]);
            ret = add(ret, 1);
        } else {
            ret = add(ret, dp[i-1][j+1][0]);
        }
    }
    if (j > 0) {
        if (selectEnd) {
            ret = add(ret, dp[i-1][j-1][1]);
            ret = add(ret, 1);
        } else {
            ret = add(ret, dp[i-1][j-1][0]);
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

int solve(int n) {
    int N = 2 * n;
    vector<vector<vector<int>>> dp(N+1, vector<vector<int>>(N+1, vector<int>(2, 0)));
    // dp[0][0][0] and dp[0][0][1] are already 0 by initialization
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= 1; k++) {
                dp[i][j][k] = 0;
                if (k == 1) {
                    if (i - j >= 2) {
                        dp[i][j][k] = add(dp[i][j][k], dp[i-1][j+1][0]);
                    }
                    if (j > 0) {
                        dp[i][j][k] = add(dp[i][j][k], dp[i-1][j-1][0]);
                    }
                } else {
                    dp[i][j][k] = max(getVal(dp, i, j, false, false),
                                      max(getVal(dp, i, j, false, true),
                                          getVal(dp, i, j, true, false)));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dp[N][0][0];
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    cout << solve(n);
    return 0;
}
